t: This is Sacred Heart Church on Trott Street in Battersea, a Roman Catholic church and parish serving Battersea's Catholic community and the neighbourhoods around it. It was designed by Frederick Walters, a Scottish architect of the Victorian and Edwardian eras. Walters is best known for his Roman Catholic churches, so this is exactly the kind of building he made his name on. He was also a numismatist, which means he studied coins and currency as well as designing buildings.
